name: Fat Mouse 84
author: virus231
description: Gradient orange button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes none, opacity becomes 80%.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fat Mouse 84</title>
<style>
/* Fat Mouse 84 by virus231 — https://uiverse.io/virus231/fat-mouse-84 */
.button {
  background: linear-gradient(140.14deg, #ec540e 15.05%, #d6361f 114.99%)
      padding-box,
    linear-gradient(142.51deg, #ff9465 8.65%, #af1905 88.82%) border-box;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;

  text-shadow: 1px 1px 1px #00000040;
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 20px 0px #45090059;

  padding: 10px 40px;
  line-height: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  color: white;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.button:hover {
  box-shadow: none;
  opacity: 80%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Button</button>

</body>
</html>
